Version objects

Source: R/history.R
versions.Rd

Loro names versions in two ways, and creditor gives each its own class so that one cannot be passed where the other is expected:

  • a version vector (class loro_version), from doc_version(), used to ask for the updates a replica is missing;

  • frontiers (class loro_frontiers), from doc_frontiers() and doc_changes(), used to name a point in history.

Both are raw vectors underneath, so unclass() gives bytes that can be stored or sent elsewhere. as_version() and as_frontiers() put the class back on such bytes. They do not convert between the two kinds; use doc_frontiers_to_version() and doc_version_to_frontiers() for that.

Usage

as_version(x)

as_frontiers(x)

Arguments

x

A raw vector.

Value

as_version() returns a loro_version and as_frontiers() a loro_frontiers.

Examples

doc = loro_doc()
text_insert(doc, 1, "a")
frontiers = doc_frontiers(doc)
frontiers
#> <loro_frontiers> 0@15603926720029133701

saved = unclass(frontiers)
identical(as_frontiers(saved), frontiers)
#> [1] TRUE
